name: release-front-page
description: Create evidence-backed release notes and self-contained release visuals from Git refs.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-backed release notes and visual front pages
interface.longDescription: Turn a local Git ref range into traceable release notes, printable HTML and SVG front pages, and a localized social card without publishing anything.
defaultPrompt: Use $release-front-page to draft release notes from two Git refs.
Use $release-front-page to create a bilingual release front page.
Use $release-front-page to verify breaking changes before a release.
